plan.narration_reading: 15 clips, hero is the substitution. Open on the dying body Out of Joint (01); 'Psalm twenty-two' on David the king (02); 'someone else's death' on the execution written early (16). David's quote: Poured Out Like Water (03), the bones on I May Tell All My Bones (05), 'suspended by the arms' on Hung by the Arms (07). 'they look and stare' on They Look and Stare (06); 'count every bone, stretched and exposed' on Wounded For Our Transgressions (19); 'onlookers stared' on Whom They Pierced (08). Landing: His Name Is Jesus (17) on 'David never saw a crucifixion'; the marks on Wounded for Us (10); the way opened (18) on 'written early'; the love on Looking Down In Love (20) for 'this is what Jesus bore to bring you home'; To Bring You Home (13); Come to Him (14). The hero Crushed So Another Goes Free (12) closes on 'He was crushed in your place' — the substitution, sped whole-clip motion.
